original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: 头部六角度. Create a SIX-VIEW head-and-shoulders photographic reference sheet in an evenly aligned 3-column by 2-row grid. Top row left to right: straight-on front; left three-quarter facing image-left; right three-quarter facing image-right. Bottom row: exact left-facing 90-degree profile; exact right-facing 90-degree profile; exact back of head with NO face visible. Entire hair, neck and shoulder collar visible in every cell. SAME face, skull and head size in every view, identical eye-level perspective, calm neutral expression throughout. Pure white background and neat white gutters. Landscape 3:2 native 1536x1024. No text, no duplicate views, no extra panels.
IDENTITY AND STYLE: Chocolate long waves, hazel-green eyes, natural warm skin. Slight variation: medium chocolate soft waves, ivory blouse with subtle gathered neckline, short fine pearl necklace.
Reference image defines the exact approved person, face, hairstyle, apparent age and upper clothing. Preserve identity, eye color, face shape, hairline, skin tone, hair and accessory design precisely. Same individual in every view, never a generic lookalike. Bright soft neutral frontal studio lighting and equal fill, consistent exposure with clear eyes and no dark face. Pure white seamless background, real fine skin and hair detail, no painterly texture or plastic skin. No text, labels, watermark, collage of different people, props, bags or added accessories. Infer unseen garment construction conservatively and consistently.  STRICT CROP: every panel is a HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS CLOSE-UP cropped at upper chest, no waist, no hips, no legs, no full-body figures. Face large enough to inspect features.
reproduction_note: 独立文生图提示词按本次角色外观与成图重建；实际生成采用已确认肖像作为图像参考，原始编辑提示词另保留。独立文生图不能保证逐像素复现。
